disclosure_review.question: If the November 3rd general election for U.S. Senate were held today, who would you vote for?
disclosure_review.methodology: co/efficient surveyed 1,113 likely general election voters in Nebraska on September 28-30, 2026, using mobile text responses and landline interviews. Results are weighted on age, gender, race, education, congressional district, and community type to reflect the likely 2026 general electorate. The margin of error is ±2.92 percentage points. Full question wording appears with each result above.

question.prompt: Who [did / will / would] you vote for in the election for U.S. Senator?
question.prompt_note_ko: 확정 투표자는 will, 그 외는 would. 미정 선호를 물어 배분했다고 적혀 있고 배분 후에도 미정이 남는다.

results_pct.label: I will not vote in this race

source_quality.limitations_ko: 정확한 공개일·의뢰자 미공개로 누적 참고 전용. 조사 종료일을 수집일로 바꾸지 않음. 같은 문서 변경·장애는 원래 수치 보존. Lidstorm은 Lindstrom에 자동 연결하지 않음. 원문 수기 검토 입력의 재생성이며 신규 다운로드가 아님.
